name: Data-driven Operator Inference
summary: Learn reduced dynamical-system operators from high-fidelity trajectories without intrusive access to the full PDE discretization.
core_idea: Regress reduced vector-field operators in POD coordinates from projected trajectories and derivatives.
innovation: Builds interpretable reduced-order dynamics from simulation data while retaining structural operator forms.
limitations: Reduced model stability and extrapolation may require additional constraints.
Numerical differentiation can amplify trajectory noise.

start_here.why: Key nonintrusive reduced-order model method paper.
start_here.focus: From snapshots to reduced operators and dynamics.
